notice: By clicking OK you allow your death history (including earlier records) to be shared and Global data downloaded. Historical contributions have no automatic expiry; closing Sync does not erase them.
initial: Choose your folder or click Detect.
no_history: No history found. Enter WoW once with the addon installed and close the game, or choose another folder.
multiple: Several accounts found. Choose one and click OK.
found: WoW found. Click OK to check and continue.
search_failed: Search could not finish. Use Choose folder.
invalid_folder: Choose a folder with Death Atlas installed and an account with saved history.
tray_failed: Could not create the system tray icon. Close Sync and try again.
about_text:
By Garkoth

Shares your deaths and downloads Death Atlas Global maps. Works with WoW closed and prepares the addon for your next session. Global data is published daily at 06:00 UTC.

Never asks for your WoW password or edits your history. Keep Sync open; use Configure to change the folder or Close to stop it.

Status: {status}
success:
Sync is running in the background.

Use its tray icon to configure or close it.
Thank you for using Death Atlas Sync.
waiting: Waiting for you to close WoW.
retry_notice: Could not update. Sync will retry automatically. See About for details.
already_open: Sync is already open. Use Configure from its system tray icon.
settings_failed: Could not open the settings. The existing file was preserved.
startup_failed: Could not update Windows startup. Check permissions and keep the EXE in a permanent folder.
error_auth: Connection unauthorized, revoked or conflicting. Contact support; do not delete your settings.
error_service: Service unavailable or new connections closed. Try again later.
error_network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection; Sync will retry.
error_tls: Secure connection could not be verified. Check the system date and connection; keep HTTPS enabled.
error_timeout: The server took too long. Sync will retry automatically.
error_invalid: Data or format not supported. Update Sync; your history was preserved.
error_file: Addon or saved history not found. Enter WoW with Death Atlas enabled, close it and choose the folder again.
error_access: Cannot access the selected files. Check folder permissions.
error_size: The data exceeds the safe size limit. Your files were preserved.
error_sharing: In WoW open /da, enable Sharing and close the game to save your permission.
error_changed: The save is changing. Wait until WoW finishes closing and retry.
error_policy: The data policy changed. Update Sync and review permission again.
error_paused: Synchronization paused or WoW was opened. Close WoW and retry.
error_revoked: This connection was revoked. Contact support to recover it.
error_unexpected: The operation could not finish. Retry; if it persists, report this code and the Sync version.
error_rate: Temporary service limit. Sync will retry automatically.
error_noapi: Service not found at this address. Try again later or contact support.
error_mixed: The edition changed during download. The previous cache was kept; Sync will retry.
error_runtime: This feature requires the packaged Windows EXE.
error_saveconfig: Could not protect or save settings. The previous file was preserved.
erasure_confirm: Remove contributions from the selected WoW installation? Sync will stop uploading. Contributions will be removed from the next successful daily edition at 06:00 UTC. Local history is kept. Older server copies expire after cleanup; copies already downloaded by others cannot be recalled. This cannot be undone.
erasure_queued: Request accepted. Uploads stopped. Removal is scheduled for the next successful daily edition at 06:00 UTC.
erasure_completed: Removal completed in the published edition. Uploads remain stopped.
erasure_blocked: This installation requested removal of its contributions. Uploads are stopped. Use About to retry or check the request.
erasure_no_key: No saved connection key for this installation. Contact support without sending keys or your history.
platform_preview: macOS/Linux preview: not tested with WoW. Without a tray icon, keep this window open or minimized. Automatic startup is not included in this build.
foreground_success: Sync is connected. Keep this window open or minimized; closing it stops synchronization. Thank you for using Death Atlas Sync.
linux_ready: Secure storage is ready. Return to setup and click OK to connect.
linux_explain: Sync protects its connection key with your desktop keyring. It never asks for your WoW password. Your saved settings are preserved.
linux_instructions: If needed, install GNOME Keyring and Passwords and Keys (Seahorse) through your package manager; an example is below. Sign out and back in, then use Seahorse to create or unlock the default Login keyring. On KDE, you can enable Secret Service in KWallet instead. Do not delete an existing keyring. Sync never runs these commands.
linux_session: No desktop session bus is available. Open Sync in your normal graphical desktop, not with sudo or over SSH.
linux_missing: No compatible keyring service is available. Set up GNOME Keyring or a Secret Service provider, then check again.
linux_locked: Your keyring is locked or unlocking was cancelled. Click Unlock with the system; only the system dialog should ask for its password.
linux_collection: No default keyring exists. Create a default Login keyring in Passwords and Keys (Seahorse), or configure Secret Service in your desktop.
linux_store: Secure storage could not be accessed. Check your desktop keyring and its permissions, then check again. Nothing was reset.
linux_key: The encryption key for existing settings is missing. Restore the original keyring or contact support. Do not delete your settings or keyring.
linux_config: Existing settings could not be opened. The file was preserved. Check your original keyring or contact support without sharing keys or settings files.
linux_open: Sync is already open. Switch to its existing window; it may be minimized.
